comment: Published deep-zoom coordinates for the verify-e2e.mjs correctness gate (not a performance corpus). Each case is a well-known zoom target whose center behavior was verified externally with an arbitrary-precision distance estimator (mpmath, escape radius 3, >= 40 guard digits over the coordinate length); the Rust twins live in mandelbrot/src/perturbation_test.rs (published_* / misiurewicz_* / exact_algebraic_* tests) and pin the same iteration bands at the wasm level. `expect` drives the pixel assertion: structure = black interior and colored escapers both present, escaped = every sampled pixel colored (nothing bounded), interior = every sampled pixel solid black.

cases.note: Perturbation-f64 pathway at the published depth; center bounded past 500k iterations, surrounding pixels escape at ~40k-66k, so 50k shows escapers around a bounded interior

140-digit coordinate on the float-exp pathway. The published render needed ~750M iterations (past MAX_ORBIT_LENGTH), so at this budget every pixel is still bounded: the gate asserts clean solid-black tiles, i.e. the border-in-set shortcut end to end

cases.source: Orson Wang 'Fractal Journey Ultra Zoom #5' as circulated, magnification 2.07e275
cases.note: 286-digit coordinate at zoom 918. As circulated it carries the truncation damage its source page warns about (true boundary distance ~1.45e-212), so the whole view escapes uniformly at ~9944: the gate asserts 286-digit parsing and float-exp rendering survive, with every pixel colored

cases.source: Same coordinate at the depth where its boundary detail is back in view
cases.note: Escape counts spread 9928-9944 across the view here (boundary ~1.45e-212 from center, view ~6e-210), all comfortably under budget

cases.source: Misiurewicz point M(4,1), Newton's method to 140 digits (residual ~1e-221)
cases.note: Exact algebraic (transcription-risk-free) float-exp target; grid pixels escape at ~800-813, the center holds to 1083

cases.source: Misiurewicz point M(2,1) = -2 exactly, tip of the main antenna
cases.note: Exact coordinate at the same depth as the e275 case; every pixel sits within ~1e-275 of the needle and escapes at ~460-930 depending on axis distance (no pixel center lands exactly on the axis)

cases.source: Misiurewicz point M(2,2) = i exactly, tip of the upper 1/3-limb dendrite
cases.note: Exact coordinate on the dendrite at zoom 918; pixels escape at ~735-740

cases.source: Misiurewicz point M(22,1) in seahorse valley, Newton's method to 1012 digits (residual ~2.4e-1099)
cases.note: Exact algebraic double-spiral center at magnification ~1.05e1000; landing fixed point multiplier |lambda|=3.03 keeps dwell at ~2090-2105 across the view, so structure renders cheaply at extreme depth. Renderer allocates 3392-bit precision here (zoom 3325 + 64 guard bits).
